## Key Projects
1. **SplitMate**: Modern expense-sharing PWA built with Astro, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, UPI QR payments, and Firebase.
2. **DocuConvert Pro**: Enterprise-grade privacy-first PDF platform featuring 34 document tools, OCR, and AI document intelligence built with React, Vite, Node.js, Python, PyMuPDF, and Docker.
3. **GenWeb.ai**: AI-powered SaaS platform transforming natural-language prompts into multi-page React/Tailwind websites using OpenRouter and Stripe.
4. **ResearchMind**: Multi-agent AI research system using LangChain, Python, Groq, Streamlit, and Tavily to generate structured reports.
5. **ISM WiFi**: Cross-platform Node.js CLI published on npm (ism-wifi) automating IIT (ISM) Dhanbad captive Wi-Fi authentication.
6. **git-smart**: AI-powered Git CLI published on npm (@reck98/git-smart) automating commits using OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
7. **Daily Trade Upstox**: Automated paper trading engine executing systematic ETF dip-buying using Python, Upstox API, Pandas, and PyXIRR.
8. **AutoRclone**: Linux CLI for automated Google Drive backups with systemd scheduling and Telegram alerts.
